categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design and manufacturing of specialized integrated circuits, MEMS sensors, and infrared imaging products. It focuses on three main technology areas: infrared (long-wave, mid-wave, short-wave), microwave, and laser sensing. Its product portfolio includes MEMS chips, ASIC processor chips, full infrared thermal imaging and temperature measurement product chains, laser and microwave products, and optoelectronic systems. The company serves both special equipment and civilian markets with products such as infrared detectors, thermal imaging modules, infrared thermal imagers, T/R components, and laser ranging modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include low-noise, low-power, high-density mixed-signal integrated circuit design; non-cooled infrared sensor focal plane array sensitive material preparation; MEMS sensor design and manufacturing; wafer-level packaging technology; infrared image processing algorithms; high-precision non-contact temperature measurement; eye-safe laser ranging technology; microwave millimeter-wave T/R components and phased array antenna technology. The company employs CMOS readout circuits, MEMS infrared sensor wafers, infrared detector chips, thermal imaging modules, and full infrared thermal imaging system manufacturing platforms. It also uses ASIC chip integration to reduce size and power consumption and enhance cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include special equipment integrators and system manufacturers, civilian security and firefighting sectors, UAV payload manufacturers, industrial intelligent control, infrared temperature measurement product integrators, and automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. Major end markets are defense and special equipment, industrial manufacturing, emergency safety, intelligent automotive (including smart driving and autonomous driving), outdoor consumer electronics, low-altitude economy, satellite communications, and IoT applications. The company also serves overseas markets in outdoor sports, industrial temperature measurement, and security visual markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries located in Yantai, Suzhou, Wuxi, Shanghai, Chengdu, Hefei, Guangzhou, and other cities. It also has overseas operations including a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong. Its sales are distributed between domestic markets (approximately 59% of revenue) and international markets (approximately 41%), with exports mainly to Europe and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and manufactures core components such as MEMS chips, ASICs, infrared detectors, and thermal imaging modules, and also produces finished infrared thermal imaging systems and microwave components. It outsources wafer fabrication for CMOS readout circuits and MEMS wafers but maintains in-house production for infrared detectors, thermal imaging modules, and finished products. The company also integrates components into subsystems and complete systems for customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in infrared, microwave, and laser sensing technologies, focusing on smaller pixel pitch, wafer-level packaging, ASIC integration, and AI-enabled image processing. It invests heavily in R&D platforms for infrared detector chips, thermal imaging modules, laser ranging, and microwave millimeter-wave integrated circuits. The company aims to expand product lines, improve production capacity and quality, and develop new markets including automotive infrared imaging and multi-spectral visual sensing. It also emphasizes building a vertically integrated ecosystem and enhancing brand recognition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of infrared thermal imaging detectors, modules, complete thermal imagers, microwave RF components, laser ranging modules, and related optoelectronic systems. The company sells mainly via direct sales to B2B customers such as system integrators and OEMs, and through distributors and e-commerce channels for consumer products. Revenue recognition follows delivery and acceptance of products, with some contracts involving negotiated pricing and milestone-based deliveries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in non-cooled infrared imaging technology, competing with international firms primarily from the US, France, Israel, and Europe in the defense and civilian markets. It is among the few Chinese companies with independent R&D and mass production capabilities for infrared detector chips and thermal imaging systems. In the microwave sector, it competes with global semiconductor leaders like Skyworks, Qorvo, Qualcomm, and domestic firms such as Zhaoshengwei and Weijie Chuangxin. The company holds a strong position in the Chinese market with growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.56 billion, a 34.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 495.77 million, up 58.21%. Total assets reached RMB 8.3 billion, growing 31.12% from the prior year, with net assets of RMB 4.81 billion, up 21.47%. The company maintains a healthy gross margin above 50% in its core infrared business and continues to invest heavily in R&D, accounting for about 19.2% of revenue. The workforce includes 1,262 R&D personnel, representing 46% of total employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological leadership and innovation in multi-dimensional sensing technologies, particularly in non-cooled infrared imaging, microwave components, and laser sensing. It offers a vertically integrated product chain from chip design to finished systems, enabling high performance, reliability, and cost competitiveness. Proprietary technologies such as the world's first 8μm pixel pitch large-format infrared detector and AI-based image processing algorithms differentiate its products. The company also focuses on customization, high-quality mass production, and comprehensive customer support to create incremental value for clients across defense, industrial, automotive, and consumer sectors.
